resolved_conflicts.explanation: FireLookout.com gives 1968 as the year the lookout was destroyed. The June 15, 1968 report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page describes grizzly damage to the station and says nothing about its loss. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: The loss date is unresolved: a 1968 destruction is not confirmed by the June 1968 report. A Spokesman-Review archive search for later 1968 coverage could settle it. The 1919 entry in the Forest Service list gives 2,500 with no unit, so the story gives the bare figure. Two YouTube videos titled as a 1968 Montana lookout that vanished came up in search; they are unsourced and were not used, but they may be worth checking against this record.
